notes: Voice mode is real now. The obsidian voice screen runs the device's on-device speech engine: partial words stream into the transcript while you speak, the waveform only breathes while the microphone is genuinely open, and every status line tells the truth (paused, processing, didn't catch that, permission off). A finished transcript offers Send to chat — your spoken words land straight in a new conversation's composer — plus Copy and Try again. Speaker toggle reads the transcript back with on-device text-to-speech; the fake voice picker is gone, replaced by an honest on-device caption. iOS gets the identical contract over its own speech engine. Same design, zero decoration-only states.
